lib/path_tracker/visit_order.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
module PathTracker
  class VisitOrder
    ORDERS = { total: ->(page) { page.visits_count }, unique: ->(page) { page.unique_visits_count } }.freeze
    def self.sort(pages, by: :total)
      pages.sort_by(&ORDERS.fetch(by)).reverse
    end
  end
end

spec/tests/reviewer_feature_spec.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require_relative '../../lib/path_tracker/page'
require_relative '../../lib/path_tracker/visit_order'
RSpec.describe PathTracker::VisitOrder do
  it 'orders by visits' do
    one = PathTracker::Page.new('/one')
    two = PathTracker::Page.new('/two')
    one.add_visit('127.0.0.1')
    one.add_visit('127.0.0.1')
    expect(described_class.sort([two, one])).to eq([one, two])
    two.add_visit('127.0.0.1')
    two.add_visit('127.0.0.2')
    expect(described_class.sort([one, two], by: :unique)).to eq([two, one])
  end
end
